title: State of the Environment Report
publisher: Government of Bermuda, Ministry of the Environment; produced by Department of Communication & Information
inspected_material: Overview of Bermuda, printed page xviii / PDF page 18; source was read online as PDF text, no original PDF bytes downloaded into this packet.
inspected_facts: Report describes Bermuda as over 150 islands and islets in the western Atlantic at approximately 32 degrees 19 minutes north, 64 degrees 46 minutes west.
Report identifies Cape Hatteras, North Carolina as the nearest point of land (965 km west) and says Bermuda is over 1,200 km north of the nearest Caribbean island.
geographic_interpretation: Supports Bermuda's physical North American placement and rejects a Caribbean placement based only on botanical convenience. It does not define the Atlas Southeastern North America envelope, establish political status, or prove jurisdictional/coastal boundaries.
reuse_terms: No open reuse license established during this review. Retain URL, existing source hash, date, page locator and short factual findings as restoration instructions; do not redistribute the PDF without checking current terms.
restoration: Retrieve the PDF directly from the official Department of Planning URL above; verify it is the same source SHA-256 before reusing the historical page-18 finding. The repository's baseline hierarchy semantic evidence also records this source URL and hash.
